nodes.name: MESA nanocubes synthesis
nodes.procedure: Topically, 3.3 mM of Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 3.3 mM of CuCl₂·2H₂O, 10.2 mM of ZnCl₂, 10.2 mM of CdCl₂, 13.0 mM of InCl₃, and 40 mM of Na₃C₆H₅O₇·2H₂O were dissolved in 2.5 ml DI water, denoted as solution A. Solution B was prepared by dissolving 20 mM of K₃[Fe(CN)₆] in 2.5 mL DI water. Subsequentially, solution A was rapidly injected into solution B at a stirring rate of 400 rpm, and the mixture was continuously stirring for 15 min. After reaction the product was precipitated by ethanol and collected via centrifugation, followed by washing twice with isopropanol and water. The product was then redispersed in 2.5 mL ethanol for further use. The molar ratio between K₃[Fe(CN)₆] and all other metal salts was fixed at 1:2.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of MESA nanocubes... molar ratio between K₃[Fe(CN)₆] and all other metal salts was fixed at 1:2

nodes.name: HESA NCs synthesis
nodes.procedure: In a standard synthesis, 2.5 mL NH₄OH (28-30%) solution was firstly diluted with 10 mL DI water. A suspension of nanocubes dispersed in 2.5 mL ethanol was rapidly injected into 6.25 mL of diluted NH₄OH solution at a stirring rate of 500 rpm, and the mixture was left to stir for 15 min. After that, the etching solution was centrifuged and washed twice with ethanol and water to remove excessive NH₄OH, followed by drying in an oven at 60°C for further use.

nodes.name: Carbon support loading
nodes.procedure: Five mg of dried HESA NCs was dispersed in 10 mL DI water and 5 mg carbon black was dispersed in 10 mL ethanol, both of which were sonicated for 20 min. The HESA NCs suspension was then added into carbon black suspension under sonication. The mixture was sonicated for another 1 h before centrifugation. Finally, the mixture was dried in an oven at 60°C for 30 min.

nodes.description: NO3RR performance in 0.5 M Na2SO4 with 100 mM NaNO3
nodes.source_text: The polarization curves for NO₃RR were acquired in a gas-tight H-cell at room temperature in a 0.5 M Na₂SO₄ solution containing 100 mM NaNO₃... Fe-HESA NCs exhibited an onset potential of -0.08 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE)... Fe-HESA NCs showed high selectivity towards NH₃ from the NO₃RR with a FE of 93.4% and a YR of 81.4 mg h⁻¹ mg⁻¹ at -0.6 V versus RHE.

nodes.description: NO3RR performance in 0.5 M Na2SO4 with 100 mM NaNO3
nodes.source_text: Fe-HESA NCs exhibited an onset potential of -0.08 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE), much more positive than that of Fe-Co NCs (-0.23 V)... the increase of current density on Fe-Co NCs was very limited (16.8 mA cm⁻² at -0.8 V).

nodes.description: Long-term stability NO3RR at -0.6 V vs RHE
nodes.source_text: The long-term stability of the catalyst was investigated by a chronoamperometry test for 150 h at -0.6 V versus RHE. As demonstrated... the current density went through a slight decrease in the first 22 h, after which it became quite stable over days... the FE and YR of NH₃ exhibited slight fluctuations around 90.8% and 84.1 mg h⁻¹ mg⁻¹, respectively, over the consecutive electrolysis cycles.

nodes.description: Operando SR-FTIR mechanistic study of NO3RR
nodes.source_text: Operando synchrotron-radiation Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (SR-FTIR) was conducted... In the SR-FTIR operation results of 3450-3150 cm⁻¹... the IR intensity corresponding to ν(N-H) of NHx species increased as the voltage decreased from -0.1 to -0.6 V... peaks observed at 1229 and 1118 cm⁻¹ were ascribed to the NO₂⁻ and *NH₂OH intermediates, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: MESA nanocubes and HESA NCs exhibit well-defined cubic morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of the MESA nanocubes were characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM)... Supplementary Fig. 1b and Fig. 2e show the SEM and BF-TEM images of the HESA NCs, revealing a cubic shape...

nodes.characterization_summary: MESA nanocubes show cubic morphology; HESA NCs reveal cubic shape with high hollowness and enhanced surface flatness, size 50-150 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of the MESA nanocubes were characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and bright-field transmission electron microscopy (BF-TEM) imaging... Supplementary Fig. 1b and Fig. 2e show the SEM and BF-TEM images of the HESA NCs, revealing a cubic shape as well as high hollowness...

nodes.characterization_summary: MESA nanocubes show {100} facet dominance with 90° profile at corners; HESA NCs preserve {100} facet with 12 nm wall thickness.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) garnered on the corner of a MESA nanocube shows a profile around 90°... indicating the dominance of {100} facet... The rectangular profile observed using HRTEM at the corner of the NC demonstrate a well-defined cubic hollow structure... wall thickness around 12 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: MESA nanocubes exhibit single-phase PBA structure with lattice expansion; HESA NCs show diminished crystallinity and lattice contraction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) was performed... The PXRD pattern exhibits a set of characteristic diffraction peaks of PBA lattice... slight shift of diffraction peaks to higher degree relative to FeCo PBA... PXRD pattern of HESA NCs shows diminished crystallinity... diffraction peaks shifted to higher degree relative to those of MESA nanocubes.

The composition of MESA nanocubes were mensurated by inductively-coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS)... demonstrating a Fe:Co:Cu:Zn:Cd:In atomic ratio of 39:6:9:10:26:10... The composition of HESA NCs was also confirmed ICP-MS... indicating a Fe:Co:Cu:Zn:Cd:In atomic ratio of 29:17:15:10:18:11.

nodes.characterization_summary: Homogeneous C, N, Fe distribution in MESA nanocubes; heterogeneous Co, Cu, Cd, In distribution confirmed by line scans.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The composition of MESA nanocubes were mensurated by... energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectrometry... The inhomogeneous elemental distributions were also confirmed by EDX line scans.

nodes.characterization_summary: Homogeneous distribution of C, N, Fe; heterogeneous distribution of other metals in MESA nanocubes and HESA NCs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image and corresponding element mapping analysis... demonstrate the homogeneous distribution of C, N, and Fe... The presence and homogeneous distribution of all elements were also verified by HAADF-STEM image...

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe-L-edge EELS reveals core@shell Fe(III)@Fe(II) distribution in MESA nanocubes; Fe(II) dominance in HESA NCs walls.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fe-Ledge electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) across the nanocube... intensive EELS profiles apparently reveal a core@shell distribution of Fe(III)@Fe(II)... Fe-L-EELS profile collected on the wall of the NC indicates the dominance of Fe(II) lattice points.

nodes.characterization_summary: Hexagonal symmetry with (220) and (02-2) diffraction spots for both MESA nanocubes and HESA NCs along [111] zone axis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystalline characteristics... investigated by selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern... hexagonal symmetry pattern was observed with clear diffraction spots of (220) and (02-2) lattice planes... Figure 2e shows the SAED pattern of the HESA NCs... similar hexagonal symmetry pattern.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe 2p spectra show Fe²⁺ at 708.5/721.6 eV and Fe³⁺ at 710.0/723.5 eV; decreased Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ ratio in HESA NCs. Co 2p shows Co²⁺/Co³⁺, Cu 2p shows Cu⁺/Cu²⁺ with increased Cu⁺ after etching.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The core-level Fe 2p spectra validate... two sets of peak doublets at binding energies of 708.5 (Fe 2p3/2)/721.6 (Fe 2p1/2) eV and 710.0 (Fe 2p3/2)/723.5 (Fe 2p1/2) eV... decreased peak area ratio of Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ after etching.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe K-edge XANES shows decreased oxidation state after etching; similar coordination environment preserved.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectra at the Fe K-edge... absorption edge position of Fe has apparently shifted to lower energy level after etching... XANES profiles before and after etching are nearly identical.

nodes.characterization_summary: FT k2-weighted EXAFS shows Fe-C, Co-N, Cu-N, Zn-N, Cd-N, In-N scattering paths confirming atomic dispersion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fe, Co, Cu, Zn, and In K-edge k2-weighted Fourier transformed (FT) extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra... demonstrates evident Fe–C, Co–N, Cu–N, Zn–N, Cd–N, and In–N scattering path.

nodes.characterization_summary: C≡N stretching at 2155 cm-1 (Fe(III)-C≡N-M) disappears after etching; 2100 cm-1 (Fe(II)-C≡N-M) persists; NH4+ at 1414 cm-1 appears.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The v(C≡N) peak at 2155 cm-1 (I) for Fe(III)–C≡N–M exists in the MESA nanocubes but disappears in the HESA NCs, whereas the v(C≡N) peak at 2100 cm-1 (II) for Fe(II)–C≡N–M is present in both samples... additional ν(N-H) peak at 1414 cm-1 of NH4+ was detected after etching.
